evidence_assertions.observation: Evaluation of the Digital Ventilated Cage® system for circadian phenotyping
evidence_assertions.value: Evaluation of the Digital Ventilated Cage® system for circadian phenotyping

evidence_assertions.subject: Study_39880968
evidence_assertions.observation: The study of circadian rhythms has been critically dependent upon analysing mouse home cage activity, typically employing wheel running activity under different lighting conditions
evidence_assertions.value: The study of circadian rhythms has been critically dependent upon analysing mouse home cage activity, typically employing wheel running activity under different lighting conditions

evidence_assertions.subject: Study_39880968
evidence_assertions.observation: Here we assess a novel method, the Digital Ventilated Cage (DVC®, Tecniplast SpA, Italy), for circadian phenotyping
evidence_assertions.value: Here we assess a novel method, the Digital Ventilated Cage (DVC®, Tecniplast SpA, Italy), for circadian phenotyping

evidence_assertions.subject: Study_39880968
evidence_assertions.observation: Home cage activity in C57BL/6J mice was recorded under a range of lighting conditions, along with circadian clock-deficient cryptochrome-deficient mice (Cry1-/-, Cry2-/- double knockout)
evidence_assertions.value: Home cage activity in C57BL/6J mice was recorded under a range of lighting conditions, along with circadian clock-deficient cryptochrome-deficient mice (Cry1-/-, Cry2-/- double knockout)

evidence_assertions.subject: Study_39880968
evidence_assertions.observation: Sex differences in circadian parameters and phase shifting responses were also observed
evidence_assertions.value: Sex differences in circadian parameters and phase shifting responses were also observed

evidence_assertions.subject: Study_39880968
evidence_assertions.observation: Cryptochrome-deficient mice showed subtle changes in activity under light/dark conditions and were arrhythmic under constant dark, as expected
evidence_assertions.value: Cryptochrome-deficient mice showed subtle changes in activity under light/dark conditions and were arrhythmic under constant dark, as expected

evidence_assertions.subject: Study_39880968
evidence_assertions.observation: Our results show the suitability of the DVC system for circadian behavioural screens, accurately detecting circadian period, circadian disruption, phase shifts and mice with clock defects
evidence_assertions.value: Our results show the suitability of the DVC system for circadian behavioural screens, accurately detecting circadian period, circadian disruption, phase shifts and mice with clock defects

evidence_assertions.subject: Study_39880968
evidence_assertions.observation: We provide an evaluation of the strengths and limitations of this method, highlighting how the use of the DVC for studying circadian rhythms depends upon the research requirements of the end user
evidence_assertions.value: We provide an evaluation of the strengths and limitations of this method, highlighting how the use of the DVC for studying circadian rhythms depends upon the research requirements of the end user

evidence_assertions.subject: Study_39371613
evidence_assertions.observation: Accurate locomotor activity profiles of group-housed mice derived from home cage monitoring data
evidence_assertions.value: Accurate locomotor activity profiles of group-housed mice derived from home cage monitoring data

evidence_assertions.subject: Study_39371613
evidence_assertions.observation: Activity is an important parameter for almost all basic and applied research areas involving laboratory animals
evidence_assertions.value: Activity is an important parameter for almost all basic and applied research areas involving laboratory animals

evidence_assertions.subject: Study_39371613
evidence_assertions.observation: Locomotor activity, the main form of energy expenditure, influences metabolic rate, muscle mass, and body weight and is frequently investigated in metabolic disease research
evidence_assertions.value: Locomotor activity, the main form of energy expenditure, influences metabolic rate, muscle mass, and body weight and is frequently investigated in metabolic disease research

evidence_assertions.subject: Study_39371613
evidence_assertions.observation: Additionally, it serves as an indicator of animal welfare in therapeutic, pharmacological, and toxicological studies
evidence_assertions.value: Additionally, it serves as an indicator of animal welfare in therapeutic, pharmacological, and toxicological studies

evidence_assertions.subject: Study_39371613
evidence_assertions.observation: Thus, accurate and effective measurement of activity is crucial
evidence_assertions.value: Thus, accurate and effective measurement of activity is crucial

evidence_assertions.subject: Study_39371613
evidence_assertions.observation: However, conventional monitoring systems often alter the housing environment and require handling, which can introduce artificial interference and lead to measurement inaccuracies
evidence_assertions.value: However, conventional monitoring systems often alter the housing environment and require handling, which can introduce artificial interference and lead to measurement inaccuracies

evidence_assertions.subject: Study_39371613
evidence_assertions.observation: METHODS: Our study focused on evaluating circadian activity profiles derived from the DVC and comparing them with conventional activity measurements to validate them statistically and assess their reproducibility
evidence_assertions.value: METHODS: Our study focused on evaluating circadian activity profiles derived from the DVC and comparing them with conventional activity measurements to validate them statistically and assess their reproducibility

evidence_assertions.subject: Study_39371613
evidence_assertions.observation: We utilized data from metabolic studies, an Alzheimer's disease model known for increased activity, and included DVC monitoring in a project investigating treatment effects on activity in a type-1-like diabetes model
evidence_assertions.value: We utilized data from metabolic studies, an Alzheimer's disease model known for increased activity, and included DVC monitoring in a project investigating treatment effects on activity in a type-1-like diabetes model

evidence_assertions.subject: Study_39371613
evidence_assertions.observation: RESULTS: The DVC data yielded robust, scientifically accurate, and consistent circadian profiles from group-housed mice, which is particularly advantageous for longitudinal experiments
evidence_assertions.value: RESULTS: The DVC data yielded robust, scientifically accurate, and consistent circadian profiles from group-housed mice, which is particularly advantageous for longitudinal experiments

evidence_assertions.subject: Study_39371613
evidence_assertions.observation: The activity profiles from both systems were fully comparable, providing matching profiles
evidence_assertions.value: The activity profiles from both systems were fully comparable, providing matching profiles

evidence_assertions.subject: Study_39371613
evidence_assertions.observation: Using DVC monitoring, we confirmed the hyperactivity phenotype in an AD model and reproduced a decline in activity in type-1-like diabetes model
evidence_assertions.value: Using DVC monitoring, we confirmed the hyperactivity phenotype in an AD model and reproduced a decline in activity in type-1-like diabetes model

evidence_assertions.subject: Study_39371613
evidence_assertions.observation: DISCUSSION: In our work, we derived robust circadian activity profiles from the DVC data of group-housed mice, which were scientifically accurate, reproducible and comparable to another activity measurement
evidence_assertions.value: DISCUSSION: In our work, we derived robust circadian activity profiles from the DVC data of group-housed mice, which were scientifically accurate, reproducible and comparable to another activity measurement

evidence_assertions.subject: Study_39371613
evidence_assertions.observation: This approach can not only improve animal welfare according to the 3R principles but can also be implement in high-throughput longitudinal studies
evidence_assertions.value: This approach can not only improve animal welfare according to the 3R principles but can also be implement in high-throughput longitudinal studies

evidence_assertions.subject: Study_39371613
evidence_assertions.observation: Furthermore, we discuss the advantages and limitations of DVC activity measurements to highlight its potential and avoid confounders
evidence_assertions.value: Furthermore, we discuss the advantages and limitations of DVC activity measurements to highlight its potential and avoid confounders

evidence_assertions.subject: Study_39763604
evidence_assertions.observation: Detection of aberrant locomotor activity in a mouse model of lung cancer via home cage monitoring
evidence_assertions.value: Detection of aberrant locomotor activity in a mouse model of lung cancer via home cage monitoring

evidence_assertions.subject: Study_39763604
evidence_assertions.observation: The DVC system was used to measure circadian activity changes indicative of lung cancer progression in KRAS and KRAS-LKB1 transgenic mouse models
evidence_assertions.value: The DVC system was used to measure circadian activity changes indicative of lung cancer progression in KRAS and KRAS-LKB1 transgenic mouse models

evidence_assertions.subject: Study_39763604
evidence_assertions.observation: The mice were housed in a Digital Ventilated Cage (DVC®) rack measuring the locomotor activity continuously for 24/7
evidence_assertions.value: The mice were housed in a Digital Ventilated Cage (DVC®) rack measuring the locomotor activity continuously for 24/7

evidence_assertions.subject: Study_39763604
evidence_assertions.observation: The progression of the tumors was monitored with MRI
evidence_assertions.value: The progression of the tumors was monitored with MRI

evidence_assertions.subject: Study_39763604
evidence_assertions.observation: The DVC system evaluated a reduction in animal locomotion during the tumor progression
evidence_assertions.value: The DVC system evaluated a reduction in animal locomotion during the tumor progression

evidence_assertions.subject: Study_39763604
evidence_assertions.observation: RESULTS: KRAS and KRAS-LKB1 mutations were induced, and the tumor formation and progression were monitored over time
evidence_assertions.value: RESULTS: KRAS and KRAS-LKB1 mutations were induced, and the tumor formation and progression were monitored over time

evidence_assertions.subject: Study_39763604
evidence_assertions.observation: DVC system registered the locomotion activity of the mice during the light and dark phases, reporting a strong reduction, mainly, in the dark phase
evidence_assertions.value: DVC system registered the locomotion activity of the mice during the light and dark phases, reporting a strong reduction, mainly, in the dark phase

evidence_assertions.subject: Study_39763604
evidence_assertions.observation: DVC methods permit a home cage monitoring system useful for tracking animal behavior continuously 24 hours a day, 7 days a week
evidence_assertions.value: DVC methods permit a home cage monitoring system useful for tracking animal behavior continuously 24 hours a day, 7 days a week

evidence_assertions.subject: Study_39763604
evidence_assertions.observation: DVC system could determine disease progression by monitoring a single animal activity in a cage and also using group-housed animals
evidence_assertions.value: DVC system could determine disease progression by monitoring a single animal activity in a cage and also using group-housed animals

evidence_assertions.subject: Study_39763604
evidence_assertions.observation: For these reasons, the DVC system could play a crucial role in identifying diseases at early stages and in testing new therapeutic approaches with a higher likelihood of efficacy
evidence_assertions.value: For these reasons, the DVC system could play a crucial role in identifying diseases at early stages and in testing new therapeutic approaches with a higher likelihood of efficacy

evidence_assertions.subject: Study_39296476
evidence_assertions.observation: Continuous locomotor activity monitoring to assess animal welfare following intracranial surgery in mice
evidence_assertions.value: Continuous locomotor activity monitoring to assess animal welfare following intracranial surgery in mice

evidence_assertions.subject: Study_39296476
evidence_assertions.observation: Locomotor activity can serve as a readout to identify discomfort and pain
evidence_assertions.value: Locomotor activity can serve as a readout to identify discomfort and pain

evidence_assertions.subject: Study_39296476
evidence_assertions.observation: Therefore, monitoring locomotor activity following interventions that induce potential discomfort may serve as a reliable method for evaluating animal health, complementing conventional methods such as body weight measurement
evidence_assertions.value: Therefore, monitoring locomotor activity following interventions that induce potential discomfort may serve as a reliable method for evaluating animal health, complementing conventional methods such as body weight measurement

evidence_assertions.subject: Study_39296476
evidence_assertions.observation: In this study, we used the digital ventilated cage (DVC®) system for the assessment of circadian locomotor activity, in addition to body weight monitoring, following intracranial stereotaxic surgery in an Alzheimer's disease mouse model (C57BL/6J/APPswe/PSEN1dE9)
evidence_assertions.value: In this study, we used the digital ventilated cage (DVC®) system for the assessment of circadian locomotor activity, in addition to body weight monitoring, following intracranial stereotaxic surgery in an Alzheimer's disease mouse model (C57BL/6J/APPswe/PSEN1dE9)

evidence_assertions.subject: Study_39296476
evidence_assertions.observation: Stereotaxic surgery did not affect the organization of circadian locomotor activity of both 7-8-week-old and 19-21-week-old mice
evidence_assertions.value: Stereotaxic surgery did not affect the organization of circadian locomotor activity of both 7-8-week-old and 19-21-week-old mice

evidence_assertions.subject: Study_39296476
evidence_assertions.observation: However, we observed that both young and old mice exhibited a significant decrease in activity during the dark phase
evidence_assertions.value: However, we observed that both young and old mice exhibited a significant decrease in activity during the dark phase

evidence_assertions.subject: Study_39296476
evidence_assertions.observation: Also, our study shows that changes in locomotor activity exhibit higher sensitivity in detecting alterations indicative of animal health compared to measuring body weight
evidence_assertions.value: Also, our study shows that changes in locomotor activity exhibit higher sensitivity in detecting alterations indicative of animal health compared to measuring body weight

evidence_assertions.subject: Study_39296476
evidence_assertions.observation: In contrast to 7-8-week-old mice, where we observed no genotypic differences in locomotor activity, 19-21-week-old APP/PS1 mice showed increased locomotor activity compared to wild-type mice
evidence_assertions.value: In contrast to 7-8-week-old mice, where we observed no genotypic differences in locomotor activity, 19-21-week-old APP/PS1 mice showed increased locomotor activity compared to wild-type mice

evidence_assertions.subject: Study_39296476
evidence_assertions.observation: Furthermore, our analyses revealed that a subset of the 7-8-week-old mice showed increased locomotor activity during the initial peak of the dark phase
evidence_assertions.value: Furthermore, our analyses revealed that a subset of the 7-8-week-old mice showed increased locomotor activity during the initial peak of the dark phase

evidence_assertions.subject: Study_39296476
evidence_assertions.observation: Altogether, our findings affirm continuous activity measurements as used in the DVC® as a highly valuable objective method for post-surgical welfare monitoring
evidence_assertions.value: Altogether, our findings affirm continuous activity measurements as used in the DVC® as a highly valuable objective method for post-surgical welfare monitoring

evidence_assertions.subject: Study_39296476
evidence_assertions.observation: Its discerning capacity not only facilitates circadian locomotor rhythm assessment but also enables the identification of individual aberrant activity patterns, possibly indicative of epileptic seizures
evidence_assertions.value: Its discerning capacity not only facilitates circadian locomotor rhythm assessment but also enables the identification of individual aberrant activity patterns, possibly indicative of epileptic seizures

evidence_assertions.subject: Study_39534023
evidence_assertions.observation: Automated home cage monitoring of an aging colony of mice-Implications for welfare monitoring and experimentation
evidence_assertions.value: Automated home cage monitoring of an aging colony of mice-Implications for welfare monitoring and experimentation

evidence_assertions.subject: Study_39534023
evidence_assertions.observation: This is especially relevant with an aging colony as their activity patterns may change as they mature
evidence_assertions.value: This is especially relevant with an aging colony as their activity patterns may change as they mature

evidence_assertions.subject: Study_39534023
evidence_assertions.observation: Home Cage Monitoring (HCM) provides valuable insights into mouse activity within the animal's own environment and can shed light on acclimatization periods and responses to husbandry activities such as cage changing
evidence_assertions.value: Home Cage Monitoring (HCM) provides valuable insights into mouse activity within the animal's own environment and can shed light on acclimatization periods and responses to husbandry activities such as cage changing

evidence_assertions.subject: Study_39534023
evidence_assertions.observation: The aim of this study was to monitor and explore changes in the activity and rest disturbance (RDI) patterns of an aging colony of male and female C57/BL6 mice
evidence_assertions.value: The aim of this study was to monitor and explore changes in the activity and rest disturbance (RDI) patterns of an aging colony of male and female C57/BL6 mice

evidence_assertions.subject: Study_39534023
evidence_assertions.observation: Data was then downloaded to investigate how the activity patterns and RDI of the mice changed over time
evidence_assertions.value: Data was then downloaded to investigate how the activity patterns and RDI of the mice changed over time

evidence_assertions.subject: Study_39534023
evidence_assertions.observation: RESULTS: As expected during the study, mice were less active during the light phase compared to the dark phase
evidence_assertions.value: RESULTS: As expected during the study, mice were less active during the light phase compared to the dark phase

evidence_assertions.subject: Study_39534023
evidence_assertions.observation: However, on arrival mice displayed heightened activity and RDI during the light phase and reduced activity and RDI during the dark phase, taking several days to adjust to baseline "acclimatized" patterns
evidence_assertions.value: However, on arrival mice displayed heightened activity and RDI during the light phase and reduced activity and RDI during the dark phase, taking several days to adjust to baseline "acclimatized" patterns

evidence_assertions.subject: Study_39534023
evidence_assertions.observation: With age, overall activity significantly decreased from 5 months until 14 months of age, after which it increased back toward baseline levels
evidence_assertions.value: With age, overall activity significantly decreased from 5 months until 14 months of age, after which it increased back toward baseline levels

evidence_assertions.subject: Study_39534023
evidence_assertions.observation: We also observed activity spikes during our monitoring of this colony
evidence_assertions.value: We also observed activity spikes during our monitoring of this colony

evidence_assertions.subject: Study_39534023
evidence_assertions.observation: Cages of mice flagged for potential stereotypy displayed sustained activity spikes in the light and dark phases
evidence_assertions.value: Cages of mice flagged for potential stereotypy displayed sustained activity spikes in the light and dark phases

evidence_assertions.subject: Study_39534023
evidence_assertions.observation: Spikes in activity during the dark phase were much more pronounced than in the light phase
evidence_assertions.value: Spikes in activity during the dark phase were much more pronounced than in the light phase

evidence_assertions.subject: Study_39534023
evidence_assertions.observation: Cage changing led to an increase in the light phase activity and RDI compared to the previous day, with no observed difference in the dark phase post-cage change
evidence_assertions.value: Cage changing led to an increase in the light phase activity and RDI compared to the previous day, with no observed difference in the dark phase post-cage change

evidence_assertions.subject: Study_39534023
evidence_assertions.observation: DISCUSSION: This study explores changes in the activity patterns of an aging colony of male and female C57/BL6 mice housed in the Digitally Ventilated Cage® system
evidence_assertions.value: DISCUSSION: This study explores changes in the activity patterns of an aging colony of male and female C57/BL6 mice housed in the Digitally Ventilated Cage® system

evidence_assertions.subject: Study_39534023
evidence_assertions.observation: We identified distinct aging phases concerning activity and RDI differences and a potential new welfare application for the DVC®, specifically for early detection of stereotypy
evidence_assertions.value: We identified distinct aging phases concerning activity and RDI differences and a potential new welfare application for the DVC®, specifically for early detection of stereotypy

evidence_assertions.subject: Study_39534023
evidence_assertions.observation: In conclusion, the adoption of HCM systems should be considered for long-term animal housing from both a welfare and behavioral perspective
evidence_assertions.value: In conclusion, the adoption of HCM systems should be considered for long-term animal housing from both a welfare and behavioral perspective
